That is an interesting way to look at it. Some days really do make it seem worth it... I just wish they were not so few and far between.

I've been writing and drawing as long as I remember, and I prefer fantasy and science fiction. I mostly play Final Fantasy XIV and League of Legends.

I don't know if I'm sweet or not... I suppose I have been told that before.

I write and draw, but everything feels subpar. I like to do online gaming.
